They opened the firm’s first office in 2011 in the heart of the derivatives industry and the options capital of the world – Chicago. Python Software Engineer Interns at Akuna have the opportunity to use cutting-edge technology while working on high-performance systems that process and analyze large volumes of trading and market data. We value innovation and hard work and want our engineers to make an impact on the firm. Whether you are interested in trading infrastructure, algorithms, exchange gateways, or data capture and analysis, there’s engaging work to be done. - Pursuing a bachelor’s, master’s, or Ph.D. in a technical field (Computer Science/Engineering, Math, Physics, or equivalent)

- Major GPA of 3.5 or above

About Zipline

Zipline is the world’s largest and most experienced drone delivery service. We are on a mission to serve all humans equally by ensuring access to food, medicine and essential goods anytime, anywhere. We design, build, and operate the world’s largest autonomous logistics system, delivering critical supplies quickly and reliably. Our team is motivated by building systems that have a direct, meaningful impact on people’s lives and by scaling the future of logistics. Does aggressively tackling cross disciplinary projects from early conceptual stages through to full field deployment sound like the way you want to spend your time? - Extracting S-parameter models from package and board designs for PCIe channels.

- Developing automated workflows for SI simulation and report generation.

- Strong analytical and debugging skills.

- Experience with Ansys HFSS, SIwave, ADS, CST, or similar simulation tools.

- Experience processing Touchstone files and channel metrics.

- Python scripting for simulation automation and data analysis.

- Experience with laboratory measurements using VNAs, oscilloscopes, or TDR equipment.

- Opportunity to work on one of the most important problems of our time
